steps.name: kgsl-dmabuf-import-ubwc
steps.subject: freedreno: opt-in import of gralloc UBWC buffers on the kgsl dma-buf path
steps.description:
FD_KGSL_DMABUF_UBWC=1 lets the kgsl dma-buf path import (not export) DRM_FORMAT_MOD_QCOM_COMPRESSED
buffers allocated by the platform gralloc. fdl6's explicit UBWC layout (metadata plane first, 64x16 tile
alignment, 256-byte pitch) matches gralloc's RGBA8888_UBWC allocation, and gallium leaves the UBWC mode
registers to the kernel's platform configuration, so the GPU, the display and the platform GLES driver
agree. Modifier queries and exports stay LINEAR, so clients allocate as before.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Pending [the branch's narrow KGSL dma-buf contract (its PR #85) rejects non-linear imports on purpose; this is an opt-in]
